summary: Granite Point Mortgage Trust Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its JPMorgan repurchase facility. The amendments raise the maximum facility amount to $651 million, extend maturity to July 28, 2028 with three 364-day extension options, adjust payment waterfall mechanics, and modify financial covenants. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. No deal terms, stake changes, or strategic actions are involved; the filing simply discloses a material credit agreement amendment and associated guarantee. There is no risk-arb angle or activity to monitor beyond ordinary facility performance.
